observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: A prayer recalls cloud, fire, instruction, food, water, and enduring care.
observations.label: Care remembered in prayer

observations.body: Cloud, fire, instruction, food, and water remain present throughout recalled rebellion.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Nehemiah 9:17–23 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The prayer does not hide rebellion or let it cancel the record of mercy.
payload.title: Mercy remembered in the wilderness
